answer: The plume counter is kept in orchard and quartz shows each reset. A bond is refunded only after 50 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. An adversary thus has to keep every alias continuously active for 50 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 2344 identities would post 727 proofs and burn roughly 71 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
